title: Runtime capability manifest and execution policy
description: Deterministic, model-independent contract decided by ADR 0017. A capability manifest describes one privileged action the broker may perform; an execution policy is the per-run admissibility envelope. Nothing here registers a semantic/learned capability (ADR 0002/0009 defer those) — only deterministic, evidence-justified actions.

executionPolicy.description: The per-run admissibility envelope. The broker refuses any action outside it with a deterministic OML_* code. Limits listed here are the ones the runtime can ENFORCE; unattested resources are named in limits.unattested and are never implied to be enforced.

workspace_root.description: Absolute path. All writes and process cwd must resolve (lexically AND via realpath) strictly inside this root.

read_paths.description: Workspace-relative paths the run may read. Empty means the whole workspace copy.

write_paths.description: Workspace-relative path prefixes the run may write. A write outside these yields OML_PATH_NOT_WRITABLE even when it is inside workspace_root.

symlink_policy.description: reject: any symlink in a target path or its parents is refused (current environment.ts behavior). reject_crossing_root: symlinks are allowed only if their realpath stays inside workspace_root.

permitted_executables.description: Allowlist. An argv[0] that resolves to no rule here yields OML_EXECUTABLE_NOT_PERMITTED. This is the gap ADR 0017 closes: process.ts today spawns any argv[0].

environment_allowlist.description: Environment variable names passed through to child processes. Everything else is stripped. Secrets must never appear here.

id.description: Stable human-readable id, e.g. node, python3, tsc.

resolved_path_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the resolved executable path string (not the binary). Null when path pinning is waived; a waiver is recorded, not silently allowed.

arg_patterns.description: For regex_per_arg; one ECMA regex per positional arg.

resourceBudget.description: Only enforced limits appear as enforced fields. Everything the runtime cannot attest is listed in `unattested` so a reader is never misled (mandatory principle 8).

unattested.description: Resources the runtime does NOT bound. Must list every resource not covered by an enforced field above. Presence here is a disclosure, not a control.

capabilityManifest.description: One privileged deterministic action. Registration requires evidence justification (promotion_status). No speculative semantic capability.

determinism.description: Only deterministic capabilities may be registered under ADR 0017; model_dependent is reserved and rejected by the loader until a causal result justifies it.

network.description: V0 capabilities are offline. Network is not attested (see resourceBudget.unattested), so a capability must not require it.

promotion_status.description: candidate: schema-valid but not admissible at runtime. registered: evidence-justified and admissible. No capability is born registered.

evidenceKind.description: What KIND of evidence the action produces. Note configured_verifier_exit is explicitly weaker than a claim: an exit code is not a proof the claim holds (mandatory principle 6/7).
